column1: # Where the portal's Settings page and ./stack config list show each key of catalog/settings.tsv: the sections, their
# order, what is common and what is rare, which settings belong to a switch, and a one-line summary for the page.
# Presentation only — what may change, how and from where stays in settings.tsv (the update helper's allowlist), and
# the full explanation is settings.tsv's note (the page shows it under "Details" and in the confirmation).
# lib/settings.sh (config_list) and portal/portal/settings.py (layout) read this file; tests/test_settings.sh checks
# that every key of settings.tsv is here exactly once.
# Section rows:  @ID  TITLE  LEDE  DOC            (DOC: a page of the repository, linked as "Learn more")
# Key rows:      KEY  SECTION  PLACE  PARENT  SUMMARY
#   PLACE    main (in its section) | more (under the section's "More settings", folded) | with (shown inside PARENT's
#            row, never on its own: the other half of a pair, a value it derives, the key a budget belongs to)
#   PARENT   - | a key of the same section: main and more rows show only while it is on (true or on; for other
#            values: set and not off) — search and "Changed from default" show them anyway, saying so
#   SUMMARY  one plain line (- for with rows)
# Rows whose KEY starts with + are the page's own rows (no .env key): +devices, +models, +backups, +test, +check-aws,
# +report, +restart, +git-hosts. Sections are shown in this order; rows in file order.
